The choice depends on the role of each term in the context, so the adult learner checks the details before moving on. Next, the adult learner considers Reporter, Cameraman, Technician, and Live. The choice depends on the role of each term in the context, so the adult learner checks the details before moving on. Next, the adult learner considers Commercial, Interview, Segment, and Headline. The choice depends on the role of each term in the context, so the adult learner checks the details before moving on. Finally, the adult learner considers Weather Map. The choice depends on the role of each term in the context, so the adult learner checks the details before moving on. By the end, the adult learner can explain the decision clearly and use the new words in a connected response.
